title: UP SCVTUP ITI Online Form 2026
organization: State Council for Vocational Training, Uttar Pradesh
postName: UP ITI Admission Session 2026-27 – All Trades
vacancyDetails: Admission to Government and Private ITIs in Uttar Pradesh for session 2026-27
qualification: Class 8 / 10 pass as per trade eligibility in SCVTUP prospectus
ageLimit: As per UP ITI admission rules for the session
selectionProcess: Online application → Merit list → Counselling / seat allotment rounds
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.scvtup.in or https://admissionscvtup.in
2. Open Trainee Registration for ITI 2026
3. Register with mobile OTP
4. Fill form, pay fee, upload documents
5. Print application; wait for merit/counselling
shortDescription: UP SCVTUP ITI Online Form 2026 – registration from 11 July 2026 at scvtup.in / admissionscvtup.in (last date ~4 Aug).
content:
State Council for Vocational Training, UP (SCVTUP) has started online registration for ITI Admission 2026–27.

Apply from 11 July 2026 (last date reported around 4 August 2026). Fee: Gen/OBC ₹250, SC/ST ₹150.

Portals: scvtup.in / admissionscvtup.in.
